title: Ethiopian Spiced Yogurt
author: Chef Haile
desc: Ethiopian Spiced Yogurt — thick natural yogurt mixed with garlic, green jalapeño, fresh mint, and lemon. The cooling condiment served alongside spicy preparations — a modern Ethiopian restaurant addition that provides dairy-based cooling for the intensely spiced dishes.
longDesc: Spiced yogurt is the modern Ethiopian restaurant's answer to the traditional Ayib — a quicker, more widely available dairy condiment that provides the same cooling function alongside hot dishes. Its green jalapeño and mint make it fresh and cooling simultaneously.
steps: Combine all ingredients in a bowl.
chefTips: Thick yogurt only — thin yogurt becomes watery with the vegetable additions.
cookingScience: Yogurt's lactic acid provides the same dairy cooling effect as ayib — the casein proteins in yogurt form a physical barrier in the mouth that temporarily reduces capsaicin's contact with taste receptors, providing relief from chilli heat more effectively than water.
servedWith: With kitfo as an ayib alternative
culturalNote: Spiced yogurt is the modern Ethiopian restaurant's gesture toward international dining culture — the familiar yogurt condiment that any global visitor recognises, given an Ethiopian character through jalapeño and mint.
